headline: Brazil MGI issues advisory AI transparency guides for federal public services
summary: Brazil's Ministry of Management and Innovation in Public Services published two implementation guides for AI transparency in federal public services: an AI System Card for documenting system purposes, processing, limits and risks, and a Transparency Design Guide for notifying users when services use AI. The complete 37-page Design Guide v1.0 scopes recommendations to federal direct, autarchic and foundational administration and says it does not regulate AI uses or replace legal duties. MGI describes the wider self-assessment framework as orienting. Publication is established; agency uptake, binding effect and public-service outcomes are not.
